Package sc.fiji.snt.analysis

Class CandidatePathMetrics

java.lang.Object
sc.fiji.snt.analysis.CandidatePathMetrics
public final class CandidatePathMetrics extends Object
Quality metrics for a set of candidate paths linking the same two endpoints (e.g., paths computed with different cost functions). Metrics are descriptive: they do not assume a ground truth and are meant to be compared across candidates (column-wise), not combined into a single score. Background statistics are pooled across all candidates so that every path is judged against the same local background.

Paths are expected to be in the voxel space of img (i.e., Path.getXUnscaledDouble(int) and friends index into img).

Author:
Tiago Ferreira

    • compute

      public static double[][] compute(Path[] paths, net.imglib2.RandomAccessibleInterval<?> img)
      Computes all metrics for a set of candidate paths linking the same endpoints.
      Parameters:
      paths - the candidate paths (null entries are allowed and yield NaN rows)
      img - the image the paths were computed on. Must be accessible at the paths' unscaled node coordinates
      Returns:
      the metric values, indexed as [pathIndex][Metric.ordinal()]. NaN means 'not computable'

    • compute

      public static double[][] compute(Path[] paths, net.imglib2.RandomAccessibleInterval<?> img, int radius)
      Computes all metrics for a set of candidate paths linking the same endpoints.
      Parameters:
      paths - the candidate paths (null entries are allowed and yield NaN rows)
      img - the image the paths were computed on. Must be accessible at the paths' unscaled node coordinates
      radius - the radius (in units of the smallest voxel side) of the cross-sectional disk sampled around each node. Should be larger than the expected radius of the neurite. Clamped to a sensible range
      Returns:
      the metric values, indexed as [pathIndex][Metric.ordinal()]. NaN means 'not computable'

    • compute

      public static double[][] compute(Path[] paths, net.imglib2.RandomAccessibleInterval<?> img, int radius, BooleanSupplier cancelled) throws CancellationException
      Computes all metrics for a set of candidate paths linking the same endpoints. Very long paths are subsampled (every k-th node) for the most expensive metrics.
      Parameters:
      paths - the candidate paths (null entries are allowed and yield NaN rows)
      img - the image the paths were computed on. Must be accessible at the paths' unscaled node coordinates
      radius - the radius (in units of the smallest voxel side) of the cross-sectional disk sampled around each node. Should be larger than the expected radius of the neurite. Clamped to a sensible range
      cancelled - polled regularly: if it returns true the computation is aborted
      Returns:
      the metric values, indexed as [pathIndex][Metric.ordinal()]. NaN means 'not computable'
      Throws:
      CancellationException - if cancelled returned true

    • isBest

      public static boolean isBest(double[][] values, CandidatePathMetrics.Metric metric, int row)
      Checks if a value is the best in its column. Values that are displayed identically to the best one (CandidatePathMetrics.Metric.format(double)) are also reported as best. At least two non-NaN values are needed in the column for any of them to be called best.
      Parameters:
      values - the output of compute(Path[], RandomAccessibleInterval)
      metric - the metric (column)
      row - the row (path) index
      Returns:
      true if the value at row is the best (or tied for best) in its column
